# Storage API support

<!-- Generated by tools/storageprobe. Do not edit; run `just docs` to regenerate. -->

This page lists the RPCs of the BigQuery Storage v1 gRPC API and whether the emulator serves them.
Their use and limits are described in the [Storage API guide](storage-api.md).

`tools/storageprobe` calls each RPC in the forms it lists, each on a table of its own. A probe
checks only that a call succeeds, not that the response matches BigQuery's. The notes of a Partial
RPC list the forms the emulator rejected.

- **Supported**: every call succeeds.
- **Partial**: some calls succeed, and the emulator rejects the others as `UNIMPLEMENTED`.
- **Unsupported**: the emulator rejects every call as `UNIMPLEMENTED`.
- **Broken**: a call fails with another error, which is a bug.

| Service | Supported | Partial |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [BigQueryRead](#bigqueryread) | 1 | 2 |
| [BigQueryWrite](#bigquerywrite) | 5 | 1 |

## BigQueryRead

| RPC | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CreateReadSession` | Partial | See [Reading rows](storage-api.md#reading-rows). Unsupported: Arrow buffer compression; JSON columns in Arrow; RANGE columns; historical snapshots; response compression; sampling. |
| `ReadRows` | Partial | Unsupported: serialization options. |
| `SplitReadStream` | Supported |  |

## BigQueryWrite

| RPC | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CreateWriteStream` | Supported | See [Lifetime and persistence](storage-api.md#lifetime-and-persistence). |
| `AppendRows` | Partial | See [Write limitations](storage-api.md#write-limitations). Unsupported: Arrow rows; GEOGRAPHY columns; JSON columns; ROUND_HALF_EVEN columns; column defaults; parameterized columns; writer schema changes on a connection. |
| `GetWriteStream` | Supported | See [Write limitations](storage-api.md#write-limitations). |
| `FinalizeWriteStream` | Supported |  |
| `FlushRows` | Supported |  |
| `BatchCommitWriteStreams` | Supported |  |
